name: Local AI Assistant
description: A local, offline LLM assistant (llama.cpp + Qwen3) with persistent memory, web search, a developer command console, and a self-editing pipeline -- most edits require human approval, but a tightly bounded autonomous mode can apply small, isolated self-improvements on its own.
systems: Natural-language command routing (registry-bound and developer-mode aware)
Offline voice conversation (Sherpa-ONNX VAD/ASR and Piper speech)
Self-editing pipeline (intent, generation, guard rails, approval)
Autonomous self-improvement (isolated from chat/search, capped and logged)

files.main.py: Entry point: typed and voice conversation loops, natural command routing, prompt/context-budget assembly, and reload-after-edit handling.
files.core/config.py: All paths, server URL, voice model/device settings, and tunables (context size, max tokens, debug flags). Protected from self-editing.
files.core/file_utils.py: Low-level file I/O: durable atomic JSON/text writes, corruption recovery, safe path joining, and project file listing.
files.core/llm_server.py: Starts, stops, and reuses the authenticated loopback llama-server subprocess, passes its generated secret through a protected key file, and waits for readiness.
files.core/health_check.py: Read-only diagnostics for model/server readiness, API authentication, storage, memory quality, live web search, and offline voice dependencies.
files.core/persona.py: The assistant's persona text and few-shot example turns.
files.core/stream_filter.py: Cleans up streamed model output (partial tags, turn markers, stray reasoning).
files.commands/command_handlers.py: Every 'dev mode' command (memory, files, project, editing) and the dispatch loop. Protected from self-editing.
files.commands/natural_command.py: Translates command-like natural language into a validated command from the live registry; protects explicit destructive actions and cannot bypass developer mode.
files.editing/edit_intent.py: Classifies whether a chat message is an edit request and which file it targets.
files.editing/edit_generator.py: Asks the model for a concrete find/replace edit for a given file and change request.
files.editing/patch_engine.py: Applies a find/replace edit and builds the diff shown to the user.
files.editing/edit_engine.py: Orchestrates propose -> preview -> confirm -> rollback for self-edits.
files.editing/edit_guard.py: Safety rails: protected runtime denylist, path containment, syntax/import checks, atomic writes, backups, and a smaller unattended allowlist that cannot add system/network capabilities.
files.editing/change_planner.py: Writes the human-readable plan files under memory/change_plans.
files.editing/approval_manager.py: Tracks which plan is currently approved for 'preview plan'.
files.editing/pending_edit.py: Holds the single edit that has been previewed and is awaiting 'confirm edit'.
files.editing/suggestion_engine.py: Generates a few self-improvement ideas grounded to real, editable files, for 'suggest'/'do <n>'.
files.editing/autonomous_engine.py: Runs one no-approval self-improvement attempt per process run. Isolated from chat/memory/search content on purpose, with a diff-size cap and full logging to logs/autonomous_edits.log.
files.memory/memory_store.py: In-memory and on-disk store for facts, conversation history, and core memory.
files.memory/memory_logic.py: Duplicate/conflict detection (is this the same fact, or an update of one?) and relevance ranking.
files.memory/memory_extractor.py: Asks the model to extract up to three durable facts per turn, structured for extraction_rules to validate.
files.memory/extraction_rules.py: Regex-based acceptance rules for extracted facts (rejects questions, meta-commentary, transient state).
files.memory/memory_extraction.py: Cheap regex-only direct memory detection ("I own an X") that skips the model entirely.
files.memory/memory_worker.py: Background thread that runs memory extraction off the chat loop.
files.project/project_mapper.py: Builds and caches the project's file/folder map.
files.project/project_analyzer.py: Summarises a single file's size and function list for 'explain file'.
files.project/project_builder.py: Generates small multi-file standalone projects into the top-level dump folder, validates paths and syntax, and never executes them automatically.
files.ui/ui.py: Terminal rendering: animated header, live activity/token/timer rows, non-blocking input, command cycling, and visible voice mode state.
files.voice/offline_voice.py: Optional offline microphone/VAD/transcription and cached Piper speech backend; imports no voice dependencies during normal text chat.
files.voice/session.py: Small request flag that hands the 'voice mode' command from the command registry to the main conversation loop.
files.voice/setup_voice.py: One-time package and model installer for Sherpa-ONNX Moonshine, Silero VAD, and Piper.
files.web/search_engine.py: Dispatches to whichever search backend is configured (SEARCH_BACKEND in core/config.py: 'searxng' or 'brave').
files.web/search_engine_searxng.py: Self-hosted SearXNG client (see searxng/docker-compose.yml at the project root).
files.web/search_intent.py: Classifies whether a chat message needs current web information and what to search for.
files.scan_bad_imports.py: Standalone lint script: flags local-package imports shadowing stdlib modules.
